report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with 60-175ms latency and zero 502s; no errors, saturation, or dependency-level metrics are present. The alert shows no clear failure, so no root-cause candidate is substantiated. Dependency-level latency/error evidence and a latency baseline are required to localize or rule out downstream-latency, db-pool-exhaustion, or redis-timeout.
missing_evidence: Per-dependency latency/error metrics for order->inventory, order->payment, order->postgresql, inventory->redis to localize the latency source
Order service logs/traces showing which downstream call dominates the ~60-175ms checkout latency
Baseline latency SLO/threshold to determine whether observed checkout durations are anomalous at all
Error-rate or saturation metrics (DB pool, redis) to rule out db-pool-exhaustion or redis-timeout
